title: Chemically Competent E. coli Cells Preparation
author: Carlos Helbig
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.psydnfw
materials: Grow 50ml over night culture in TYM medium
Aliquot the cells into chilled tubes (50µl aliquots)
Freeze the cells in liquid nitrogen

steps.title: Grow culture to target OD
steps.instruction: Incubate the E. coli culture until the optical density reaches 0.55 at 37 °C while shaking at 200 rpm.

steps.title: Cool cells on ice
steps.instruction: Place the culture on ice to chill the cells.

steps.title: First centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the chilled cells at 3500 g for 15 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Resuspend in TfB1 buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 100 mL ice‑cold TfB1 buffer.

steps.title: Second centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge again at 3500 g for 15 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Resuspend in TfB2 buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 30 mL ice‑cold TfB2 buffer.

steps.title: Store cells at -80°C
steps.instruction: Aliquot (if desired) and store the competent cells at –80 °C.
